description: Defines a priority task queue class with methods for pushing, popping, and managing tasks based on priority, including internal conversion functions for priority-to-queue index mapping.

classes.name: priority_task_queue
classes.description: A concurrent, prioritized task queue supporting multiple priority levels with blocking and non-blocking operations.

classes.name: priority_task_queue::consumer_type
classes.description: A consumer interface for popping tasks from the priority queue, not thread-safe.

methods.name: enqueue_priority_to_queue_index
methods.description: Converts enqueue priority to queue index based on the number of priority levels.

methods.name: queue_index_to_enqueue_priority
methods.description: Converts queue index back to enqueue priority.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes a task into the queue, blocking if the internal queue is full.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push a task into the queue without blocking; returns false if full.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop a task considering priority; returns false if empty.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple tasks in bulk considering priority.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::pop_blocking
methods.description: Blocks until a task is available to pop, or until stopped.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::request_stop
methods.description: Interrupts all blocking operations to stop the queue.
